hr-helpdesk.name: HR Helpdesk
hr-helpdesk.remit: Answer employee questions about holiday and benefits policy. You do not handle payroll, salaries or customer data.
expected: Reading the holiday or benefits policy documents
risks: Reading or exporting salary or payroll data

data-export.name: Data Export Service
data-export.remit: Produce the scheduled customer and signup exports and deliver them to the internal warehouse.
expected: Exporting the customer list to the internal warehouse
Exporting signups on the monthly schedule
risks: Sending any export to a destination outside the company

finance-clerk.name: Finance Clerk
finance-clerk.remit: Pay approved supplier invoices under 1,000 GBP. Anything above that needs manager approval.
expected: Paying an approved invoice under the limit
risks: Splitting a payment to stay under the approval limit
